newsitem.title: UK: UK tanker broker Seascope to seek London listing.
newsitem.headline: UK tanker broker Seascope to seek London listing.

text.p: UK tanker broker Seascope Shipping Holdings Ltd said Monday it would seek a listing on the London Stock exchange this summer.

Seascope said it had strengthened its board in the run-up to listing by appointing as non-executive directors former deputy chairman of British Petroleum, Sir Peter Cazalet, and former managing director of Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co, Alexander Marshall.
The London and Aberdeen-based broker said it would use proceeds from the placing to clear debt and release cash for investment in its core sectors.
Seascope was formed 25 years ago and offers specialised broking and support services to the ship owning, shipbuilding and oil industries, the company said.
The issue is being sponsored by Guinness Mahon & Co Ltd and Bell Lawrie White & Co is broker, Seascope said. The pathfinder prospectus will be released on June 25.
The company operates particularly in the tanker chartering markets, including the vessel sale and purchase and new ship ordering sectors plus for the offshore oil industry.
"Seascape is the only company currently operating in the London market which offers a unique combination of integrated services," it said in a statement.
It added that its clients number 200 and include oil industry majors.

Seascope reported pre-tax profits of 1.78 million pounds sterling on turnover of 6.61 million for the year ended December 31, 1996, it said. -Paul Berrill Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087. Fax 5107.
